title: Prove the exact block broadcast cost at P104 packet 3300
body:
## Result

In the four reduced fixed-prefix cases of #8021, packet 3300 needs exactly two bits per copy for owners 184 and 189, even for arbitrary deterministic block coding and free access to the relaxed side stocks. The two demands have rank two on a common 13-dimensional source-view difference space. The archive gives native lifts for a two-dimensional clique and two separate feasible source rows for each case. The general capacity model is related to [Yao and Jafar](https://doi.org/10.1109/LCOMM.2022.3188948). The source-bound repeated-copy proof and the priced native-ingress screen are new here. This starts from the reduced prefixes and makes no nonlinear claim for their earlier case reduction.

The exact atlas test covers all 234 non-increasing-grade alternatives at the eight actual terminal ingress clocks in each reduced case. The six that could restore both relaxed receivers after removing the old payload all use early chart-1 stock. Each leaves 536 effective bits for chart 1’s 537 independent outputs. The counting proof follows the three returning packets and their real prefix. The remaining cases fail the relaxed stock test. Changed clocks, more than one paid retarget, and changed early fixed equations remain open.

## Replay

Exact #8021 `0a693d83e85eda96a863d1ea262f4f733f01abc0`, native #7786 `89a67c404226d51028e135de2b9169e9020d57af`, and comparator #7830 `87fbf4f7b35b0f18ab12b5767775a9a424cf0b15`. Archive SHA-256 `4a436a539125ee0b3a22114abbf5ce0bb3af5d373c893492e492aed92df5eb82`. From a fresh extraction, `sha256sum -c SHA256SUMS`, `python3 -I -B verify_broadcast.py` and `python3 -I -B screen_ingress.py` passed. A corrupted one-bit receipt was rejected.

## Prior work and open next questions

#8020 changes the owner-17 input chart and is outside this proof. #8022 checks frozen-chart productive helper destination swaps, whereas this changes a terminal ingress sender. A next construction must provide an independent outside observation or simultaneously restore chart 1’s lost ingress. No new κ is established.

Canonical main `e54523517d0f03e58352e647c403a5af3e525a57`. The comparable complete bound comes from #7863 `b3e4412fe01f07dc58305616fabf96345f49a781` and replay #7973 `ac3df5d5c8889f464f575e32dfea43714abf08ca`. Clear1nsight prepared this proof with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Credit DreamingOfClouds and the native, caller, and verifier contributors retained in the archive.
